title: Optimization: Gradient Descent and Its Variants
description: The algorithms that actually adjust a model's weights during training.
learningOutcomes: Explain batch, stochastic, and mini-batch gradient descent
Explain momentum and adaptive learning rate methods
Diagnose a training run from its loss curve

lessons.title: Batch, Stochastic, and Mini-batch Gradient Descent
lessons.description: Why almost no real model uses full-batch gradient descent.
learningObjectives: Explain the difference between the three variants
Explain why mini-batch is the practical default
Connect batch size to training speed and noise

lessons.title: Momentum and Adaptive Methods
lessons.description: Why Adam, not plain gradient descent, is the default optimizer.
learningObjectives: Explain what momentum adds to gradient descent
Choose a reasonable default optimizer for a new model

lessons.title: Learning Rate and Schedules
lessons.description: The single hyperparameter most likely to break training.
learningObjectives: Explain the effect of a learning rate that's too high or too low
Read a loss curve to diagnose a bad learning rate

lessons.title: Diagnosing a Training Run
lessons.description: Read a loss curve like a doctor reads a chart.
learningObjectives: Diagnose divergence, plateauing, and oscillation from a loss curve
Propose a fix for each failure pattern
Connect this lesson back to a real PyTorch training loop
